title: Endogenous Heteroskedasticity in Linear Models
abstract: arXiv:2412.02767v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Linear regressions with endogeneity are widely used to estimate causal effects. This paper studies a framework that involves two common practical issues: endogeneity of the regressors and heteroskedasticity that depends on endogenous regressors, i.e., endogenous heteroskedasticity. To address the inconsistency of the two-stage least squares estimator in this scenario, and recover the causal parameters of interest, we develop a framework for practical estimation and inference based on the control function approach allowing for discrete and continuous regressors. In particular, we suggest a simple two-step estimation procedure. We establish the limiting properties of the estimator, namely, consistency and asymptotic normality. In addition, we develop practical valid inference methods by proposing an estimator for the asymptotic variance-covariance matrix, and formally establishing its consistency. translated_title: 线性模型中的内生异方差性
translated_abstract: 含内生性的线性回归被广泛用于估计因果效应。本文研究了一个涉及两个常见实际问题的框架：回归变量的内生性，以及依赖于内生回归变量的异方差性，即内生异方差性。为了解决两阶段最小二乘（2SLS）估计量在这种情形下的不一致性，并恢复感兴趣的因果参数，我们基于控制函数方法开发了一个实用的估计与推断框架，该方法同时适用于离散和连续回归变量。特别是，我们提出了一个简单的两步估计程序。我们建立了该估计量的极限性质，即一致性和渐近正态性。此外，我们通过提出渐近方差-协方差矩阵的估计量并正式证明其一致性，开发了实用的有效推断方法。蒙特卡洛模拟为该方法的有效性提供了证据。
tldr: 本文针对线性回归中同时存在回归变量内生性和内生异方差性导致两阶段最小二乘估计不一致的问题，提出了基于控制函数方法的两步估计程序，证明了其一致性与渐近正态性，并给出渐近方差-协方差矩阵的一致估计量以实现有效的统计推断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-step estimation procedure based on the control function approach to address endogenous heteroskedasticity in linear regressions where two-stage least squares is inconsistent, establishing the estimator's consistency and asymptotic normality and providing a consistent estimator of the asymptotic variance-covariance matrix for valid inference.
